desc: Define the four diagonal direction vectors and their clockwise successor mapping.
Derive straight continuation DP for the sequence `1, 2, 0, 2, 0, ...` with correct expected-value phases.
Combine initial-direction and clockwise-successor continuation lengths without double-counting the turning cell.
Specify iterative scan orders for all four diagonal directions and ensure O(nm) time and space.
Verify the implementation against all examples, single-cell and boundary cases, and large inputs.
